answer: Before an identity can grade peers, it must post a velvet bond of 500 governance tokens, locked on-ledger like a ship's manifest before a voyage. Each epoch, a random verifier samples that agent's grades against the consensus river of sealed scores; if divergence exceeds 12%, the bond is slashed 40% and redistributed to honest auditors. A permanent slash trail then marks the key, so spinning up 1,000 sockpuppets risks 500,000 tokens instead of buying cheap votes.
